Article 14 provides that non-original reproductions of visual artworks whose protection term has expired are not subject to copyright or related rights in EU Member States.
German section 68 states that reproductions of public-domain visual works are not protected by related rights under the specified parts of the Act.

Tretyakov Gallery states non-commercial conditions for images from its collection, requires written permission for commercial use of its site materials, and offers digital museum-object images and usage rights by written paid agreement after a positive decision.
Tretyakov Gallery states that digital images of collection objects and rights to use them may be provided to legal entities and individuals under a paid written contract after a positive decision.

Article 36 assigns museums the transfer of rights for commercial use of reproductions of museum objects in the Museum Fund and requires museum-management permission for specified reproduced/printed goods using museum-object images.
